note: Poses: the body origin is the left camera's optical centre (the reference imager; ASSUMPTION: the sources do not say which camera the depth map is referenced to). Positions are Luxonis's design ("spec") translations from its own calibration board file (depthai-boards, specTranslation in cm, rotation zero): the right camera one baseline along -y and the centre camera at the baseline midpoint; a unit's own calibration differs from these design values. Interface: the docs page says "USB 2/3 (up to 10 Gbps)", the datasheet "USB3.1, gen2 10gbps" with output "via USB 3.1 Gen1", the store page "USB-C (USB 3.2 Gen1, 5 Gbps)"; USB 3.2 Gen 1 is entered. Lens model pinhole is a labelled ASSUMPTION fitted to the stated FOV (no distortion is stated). Not stated by the maker: subpixel accuracy, lens distortion, depth FOV (the depth map takes the reference camera's FOV; not stated separately, so depth_fov is null). Streams are the sensor modes the RVC2 driver supports, each with its maximum frame rate only (Luxonis sensor pages; lower rates are configurable but not listed); the format on the USB link depends on the on-device pipeline (raw, NV12 or H.264/H.265/MJPEG encoded), so format and bits_per_pixel are null, and no depth stream is listed (its resolution follows the chosen stereo mode). Variant entered: auto-focus IMX378 (78/66/54 deg D/H/V, EFL 4.81 mm). The fixed-focus IMX378 variant is 82/69/55 deg (EFL 4.74 mm) and the OV9782 variant a 1 MP global-shutter colour camera at 89.5/80/55 deg; calibrate or edit the entry for those. Projector: the IR dot projector's field of illumination is the datasheet's HFOI 61 +/- 4 deg, VFOI 78 +/- 4 deg (vertical wider than horizontal, as stated); its position is not stated: placed at the baseline midpoint as an ASSUMPTION (pose_stated false). The flood LED (FOI 80 deg, 940 nm) is not entered as a projector. The docs page states no projector FOV. Conflicts: MinZ and ideal range as for OAK-D (docs ~80/~40/~20 cm, entered; store ~70/~35/~20 cm, ideal 70 cm - 12 m); the docs page says "Pro devices might consume up to 15W" while the datasheet and store page give 7.5 W (entered). Stereo cameras are IR-sensitive (no IR-cut, 940 nm notch in production per the datasheet). Size 97 x 29.5 x 22.9 mm: the datasheet labels it W x D x H as 97 x 22.9 x 29.5. Depth accuracy is a median absolute error, not RMS. max_range_m is the store page's maximum effective depth range.

depth.range_text: Ideal range ~80 cm - 12 m (docs; store page 70 cm - 12 m); maximum effective depth range 30 m (store page)

rms_error.text: Median absolute depth error below 2% below 4 m, below 4% at 4-7 m, below 6% at 7-10 m (800P, 75 mm baseline; not an RMS figure)
